title: Truthful or Fabricated? Using Causal Attribution to Mitigate Reward Hacking in Explanations

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual evaluation using a pronoun resolution task (BiasQA based on WINOGENERATED) to measure the rate of stereotypical male or female pronoun selections associated with specific professions, and assessing if models acknowledge this reliance on gender stereotypes in their Chain-of-Thought explanations.
